name: Antidote
description: Cures a poisoned Pokémon. In battle.

name: Paralyze Heal
description: Cures paralysis — the Pokémon can act this very turn. In battle.

name: Burn Heal
description: Cures a burn. In battle.

name: Ice Heal
description: Thaws a frozen Pokémon — it can act this very turn. In battle.

name: Ether
description: Gives the Pokémon in battle one reroll back (up to its maximum).

name: Max Ether
description: Gives the Pokémon in battle three rerolls back (up to its maximum).

name: Rare Candy
description: Raises a Pokémon by one level. Use it from the Team screen.

name: Poké Ball
description: Adds 1 to the catch die.

name: Great Ball
description: A good ball: adds 2 to the catch die.

name: Ultra Ball
description: A high-performance ball: adds 3 to the catch die.

name: Friend Ball
description: A ball from the Friend Market: adds 3 to the catch die, as an Ultra Ball does.

name: Master Ball
description: The best ball there is. It never misses.

name: Raid Ball
description: A ball made for raids: adds 5 to the catch die. It can only be thrown in a raid.

name: Potion
description: Restores 20 HP to one Pokémon.

name: Super Potion

name: Hyper Potion

name: Revive
